carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by sharp vertical luminance gradients with light-toned upper surfaces and shadowed lower boundaries running parallel to the dorsal contour.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: A non-natural black arrow annotation points to a region of pattern disruption posterior to the fifth gill slit. A slight notch or irregularity is visible on the posterior trailing edge near the apex of the first dorsal fin.
other_distinctive_markers: A highly distinctive region of labyrinthine vermiculation (wavy high-intensity lines) is present immediately posterior to the branchial region, preceding the transition into standard circular spot clusters.
